' Those k holes keep on goin' '
I write this as I am still quite inebriated by this tri-fecta of wonderful substances.
I come home from a minimum day and snort (insufflate) about 1/5 of my bag of ketamine which weighs out to about .3 grams. I immediatly feel a strong burn and extreme euphoric rush to my brain. I start to hallucinate waves and lines in my wall and space out for about 20 minutes then fall asleep.
I wake up 2 hours later and take another big bump of the K and put myself immediately back into the k-hole. My girlfriend calls and I then go to hang out with her and some friends at the park while I'm retarded as hell.
I arrive at the park about 30 minutes later and take another bump of K, and begin to smoke some very high potency Cannibis. I take about 5 hits and follow that with another bump of K.
After about 3 hours of walking around and laughing I go home and finish the rest of my K and snort 2 vicodin. I proceed to zone in and out-of conciousness with a euphoric rush iv never felt before. The hallucinations of patterning, colors, and object matrixing was unbelieveable.
My overall summary of this 'trip' is that I had a wonderfull time. Ketamine is definatly not a substance to overabuse because it is very potent stuff.
